purpose: Replace an expectation with a much more extreme or opposite fact.
keywords: Plain clause / N + どころか
Far from being cool, it is cold enough to need a jacket.
He can do much more than swim; he has won a competition.
Far from resting, she was working at the weekend too.
formation: Plain clause / N + どころか
restrictions: The second clause overturns or greatly exceeds the first.
mistake: Keep the contrast or escalation clear.
